== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used (all Internet Archive captures of swccgpc.com, opened and checked):
* https://web.archive.org/web/20030424234849/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/scryenews04202003.htm (20 April 2003 schedule)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20031229115404/http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/may03archives.htm (May 2003 news: 12 May card list reason, spoilers 25–28 May, new visual format 30 May)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20030613002913/http://swccgpc.com/News/VirtualCards/vset5cardlist05122003.htm (12 May 2003 card list)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20030613013726/http://swccgpc.com/News/duaneevolution05212003.htm (Duane Bruun, part 1, 21 May 2003)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20030809102440/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/duaneevolution05272003.htm (Duane Bruun, part 2, 27 May 2003)
=== Build notes ===
* The Development section links each card to its original 2003 slip article, since the articles describe the cards before release. The card-by-card changes could also be added to each card article and to [[Playtest changes (Players Committee)]]; not done here.
* Part 1 says Taylor and Olson "initially create about 25 cards and then send them to each other"; it is not clear whether that is 25 in total or 25 each, so the text keeps the source's wording.
* The Alert My Star Destroyer! (V) origin (Bruun's own idea) is in part 1 and was added with the rest.
